description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to disconnect or revoke this connection. Permanently revoke its current OAuth grant immediately; the revoked credential cannot be restored. Fresh explicit consent creates a new grant while the original session is eligible. Stops future reads without deleting the source session or results already in this conversation. Other connections can be revoked on the website. This tool changes access and is destructive access revocation; it does not retrieve statistics or answer period comparisons.
name: disconnect_conversation
title: Disconnect your selected conversation
